accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:connected-saddle, thm:certified-computation, and tldr
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The decision and certification claims are conditional on the explicitly defined fixed-J abstract Gaussian experiment, one exact decidable input, and one exact incompatibility witness; no sampled-data transport or data-driven radius selection is asserted.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The headline is a pointwise abstract-Gaussian decision/certification result only, not a finite-sample or asymptotic guarantee for observed hidden-treatment data.

source_verification_receipts.version: Technical Report 617, revised May 2003; corroborative pre-publication version of the Bernoulli article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For the bounded N(theta,1) model with theta in [-tau,tau], Corollary 2 states that truncated Pratt attains minimax expected measure when tau <= 2 z_(1-alpha), and is not minimax above that threshold.
The paper presents a Monte Carlo approximation to a Gamma-minimax expected-size confidence procedure with a convex set of priors supported on a finite subset of the parameter space.
Theorem 7 assumes a P-Donsker evaluated influence-function class, Assumptions 2–5, bounded Y, and specified nuisance-rate products, and concludes asymptotic normality of its estimator.
A uniform approximation error epsilon changes coverage probability of the approximated confidence set from nominal 1-alpha by at most epsilon.
The smooth observed-law fiber is a finite set under the stated degree condition and otherwise is diffeomorphic to a disjoint union of polyhedra, hence a manifold with corners.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Split the full-data law from its observed marginal, define all latent conditionals under the full law, and either add explicit causal consistency/identification conditions or consistently relabel the project as an abstract latent-mixture decision problem.

Replace the Zhou handle by a fully specified same-array latent-data class and an explicit score-map domain; alternatively formulate the question entirely in observable tangent quantities and remove latent margins from Mcom.

Make the field contribution easier to evaluate by adding one non-singleton curved-fiber certified numerical instance with reported primal-dual brackets and a direct comparison against the calibrated profile hull.

recommended_next_step: Revise the full-data/observed-data formalization and the Zhou comparison domain, then continue this abstract-Gaussian field-tier angle.
